meta_title: A1 Fine Choice Gardening | Landscape Gardener Manchester
meta_description: A1 Fine Choice Gardening brings expert landscape design and maintenance to Manchester. From garden transformations to regular upkeep, we deliver outstanding results. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Landscape Gardening Specialists — Manchester & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to a garden you'll love spending time in. A1 Fine Choice delivers expert design and meticulous care.
services_subhead: Whether you need a complete garden overhaul or regular maintenance, we handle it all with precision and care.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke landscape design tailored to your space, budget, and lifestyle. We turn your vision into a functional, beautiful garden you'll use all year round.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Professional patio laying, raised beds, fencing, and pathways. Every project built to last using quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Planting & Softscaping
services.desc: Expert plant selection and placement to add colour, texture, and privacy. We choose species suited to Manchester's climate for year-round appeal.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Fortnightly or monthly upkeep including lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal pruning. Keep your garden looking pristine without the effort.

services.title: Lawn Care & Renovation
services.desc: From seeding and aeration to moss treatment and scarification. We restore tired lawns or create new ones that thrive in our climate.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Hedge Work
services.desc: Safe removal, pruning, and shaping of trees and hedges. We handle everything from tidy-ups to mature tree work with full insurance coverage.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I love turning neglected gardens into spaces where families actually want to spend time.
about_para_1: A1 Fine Choice Gardening was founded on a simple belief: your garden should be as beautiful and functional as the rest of your home. With nearly two decades of experience in landscape design and horticulture, we've transformed hundreds of Manchester gardens — from small urban plots to sprawling suburban spaces. We're fully insured, use sustainable practices wherever possible, and take pride in leaving every site cleaner than we found it.
about_para_2: Our customers keep coming back because we listen, we deliver what we promise, and we genuinely care about the long-term health of your garden. We're not here to upsell you; we're here to create an outdoor space that works for your life. Whether it's a one-off redesign or ongoing maintenance, you'll work with experienced gardeners who know Manchester's soil, climate, and seasonal rhythms.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our back garden was completely overgrown and we had no idea where to start. The team came in, gave us a brilliant consultation, and transformed it into somewhere we actually use now. Professional, tidy, and fair pricing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Been using A1 Fine Choice for regular maintenance for two years now. They're reliable, they show up on time, and the garden always looks immaculate. Much better value than the bigger firms and they actually care about what they're doing.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Had a massive oak tree that needed taking down safely. They quoted fairly, completed it in a day, and removed all the waste. Proper job and no mess left behind. Will definitely call them again when the hedge needs work.
reviews.author: Michael R.
